title: Sobel edge outline pass
purpose: Find edges in a three.js frame from the Sobel gradient of its luminance and draw them as soft ink outlines over the image or alone over a background colour, as a ShaderPass definition or full-screen ShaderMaterial, with a CPU mirror of the gradient and mask for luminance arrays.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: three.js r155 or later passed in as THREE (the shader includes the colorspace_fragment chunk and an int uniform); only 0.186.1 was run.

contract.language: ECMAScript 2020 module; GLSL ES 3.00 through three.js ShaderMaterial

exports.name: createSobelEdgesShader
exports.summary: A fresh shader definition for three.js ShaderPass or ShaderMaterial.

exports.name: createSobelEdgesMaterial
exports.summary: The definition as a full-screen ShaderMaterial without depth test or write.

exports.name: sobelMagnitude
exports.signature: sobelMagnitude(luma, width, height, x, y) -> number
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the gradient magnitude at one pixel, clamped borders.

exports.name: sobelEdgeMask
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the edge mask for every pixel.

exports.name: luminance
exports.summary: Rec. 709 luminance of a linear RGB value.

exports.name: SOBEL_EDGES_FRAGMENT
exports.summary: Fragment stage: 3 x 3 Sobel on luminance and the mask.

options.name: threshold
options.meaning: Gradient magnitude where the mask is half on.

options.name: softness
options.meaning: Half width of the mask transition in magnitude units.

options.name: backgroundColor
options.meaning: Colour behind the edges in edges mode.

options.name: mode
options.meaning: Outline over the image, or the edges alone.

options.name: opacity
options.meaning: How strongly the edges are drawn.

options.name: resolution
options.meaning: Input size in pixels; sets uTexelSize to its reciprocal.

limits: Edges come from luminance alone, so two colours of equal luminance give no edge, and texture detail and noise give edges too; depth and normal discontinuities are not used. Lines are one to two pixels wide at any distance and are not antialiased beyond the soft threshold. uTexelSize must match the input size, or lines thicken or break. Thresholds act on the values the pass receives (linear in three.js's pipeline). Output goes through three.js's output colour space conversion. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Sobel operator: 3 x 3 derivative kernels with centre weight 2
Smoothstep threshold of the gradient magnitude
